digest.component_or_area: store git operation locking (gitutil._with_index_lock_retry and advisory serialization)
propositions: Local git lock contention (index.lock, ref locks) causes errors under high concurrency of rebar agent processes and must be absorbed automatically without escalation.

Per-store advisory lock with bounded jittered retry/backoff on store git call sites allows transient conflicts to resolve silently while only a genuinely stuck lock (after budget exhaustion) surfaces one actionable error naming the lock file.
Uncontended local git writes must add zero latency (non-blocking advisory lock fast path, no sleep on happy path) while contended operations retry with uniform[0.75,1.25] jitter.
Each local-only git call site must be explicitly bounded with a watchdog timeout (120s for plumbing, 300s for metrics) justified against local latency, not copied from network values.
Blocking policy is bounded jittered retry with silent transient recovery and advisory serialization, consistent with git lockfile.c and Gitaly's approach, not block-forever or fail-fast.
